title: Astrolabe Roadmap Pillar
description: One pillar of the Astrolabe product feature registry. Each YAML file under roadmap/ holds one pillar.

prefix.description: Three capital letters that begin the id of every feature in this pillar.

title.description: Declarative Title Case name for the pillar.

order.description: Display order of the pillar, starting at 1.

summary.description: One clear ASD-STE100 sentence on what the pillar covers.

id.description: Pillar prefix, hyphen, and two or three digits.

title.description: Declarative Title Case noun phrase without a colon.

status.description: shipped: available in Astrolabe today. planned: scheduled for a future Astrolabe release.

scope.description: Role on the product path. core: primary workstation capability or direct dependency. supporting: engineering, test, bundle, or verification tooling. peripheral: extended multi-host or capacity capability.

summary.description: One clear ASD-STE100 sentence on what the feature does.

depends_on.description: Feature ids that this entry directly requires. Each id forms a graph edge.

docs.description: Docs path from the repository root with an optional heading anchor. Required for shipped features.
